name: Slow dependency
description: Payments becomes six times slower. Requests pile up, time out, and keep consuming downstream capacity.

phases.name: Steady traffic
phases.description: Observe the healthy system before changing its environment.

phases.name: Disturbance
phases.description: Payments becomes six times slower. Requests pile up, time out, and keep consuming downstream capacity.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Restore the environment. Queued and timed-out requests still have to finish.

phases.name: Steady again
phases.description: Observe recovery under the original offered traffic.
